dependencies.required_evidence: target-scale F-over-P gain with causal S control

contract.coder_residual: r_code[t] = y[t] - c[t] / C, where c[t] and C are the exact integer arithmetic-coder probability inputs
contract.gradient_interpretation: straight-through causal eligibility signal, not the exact derivative of the quantized coder

arms.K: compute all residual, sensitivity, feature, eligibility, and adapter state but inject zero
arms.R: inject through independent matched-norm random reconstruction maps
arms.D: inject through tied transpose B_i and B_z reconstruction maps
arms.S: use D with a frozen causal permutation of first-half event associations

contract.unchanged_state: cells 32:256, forget gates, output gates, and all unselected arithmetic receive zero injection
contract.parent_update_invariant: ordinary persistent CMIX updates continue at exactly their original call sites and cadence
unbound_fields_that_block_activation: coefficient generation or fitted coefficient digests
FP32 accumulation order and conversion rules
FMA, FTZ, DAZ, and rounding policy
exact gate and logit injection symbols

activation_requirements: Every unbound field is frozen byte-for-byte in a new executable experiment contract
P/K identity is established before any treatment result is interpreted
The finite-coder package ceiling and resource guard are bound to the invocation
claim_boundary: v2 is a dormant mathematical design and has produced no archive
Random reconstruction is control R and cannot represent target-bearing D
No projected gain is treated as measured savings
